title: How to Actually Connect GitHub to Claude Code
description:
Heads up if you're connecting GitHub to Claude Code: the current official GitHub plugin from Anthropic is broken right now. There's a bug — reported on GitHub itself — that stops it from working. 

So here's the alternative: install GitHub through the default MCP server instead. GitHub is too important to skip. It lets you checkpoint and save your code, automatically create remote repositories to share across people and devices, track all your project's progress, and roll back to an earlier version when something goes wrong. 
Here's how to get it working.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer #programming
